title: OSF UI View Manifest
description: Schema for views/<modId>/<viewName>/manifest.json. Mirrors src/Views/ViewManifest.cpp. Unknown keys are allowed. Bridge protocol 2.0.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by the OSF UI runtime.

title.description: Friendly name for view. Defaults to the qualified id.

description.description: One-line blurb shown in catalogs. Defaults to empty.

entry.description: Relative path to the entry HTML, inside the view folder. Absolute paths and any '..' component are rejected.

width.description: Initial view width. The d3d12 compositor resizes the view to the screen aspect at runtime; author responsive CSS.

transparent.description: Render with an alpha channel so the game shows through unpainted areas.

kind.description: View kind. menu = modal overlay that may capture input and occupies the single active-menu slot; hud = passive overlay over gameplay that never captures input, pauses, or focuses. Opening a menu replaces the previous active menu. Unknown values fall back to menu.

capturesInput.description: Menu-only: while this is the active menu, route input into the page. Forced false for HUDs.

pausesGame.description: Menu-only: pause the simulation while this is the active menu. Forced false for HUDs.

openOnStart.description: Normal discovery: the author DEFAULT for a HUD's automatic start at game launch; the player's per-HUD choice in Mod Settings overrides it, and discovered menus never auto-start. Explicit native-plugin RegisterView is a separate opt-in path where true opens the registered view immediately, including a menu.

order.description: HUD-only within-band paint order (clamped 0..999): higher draws on top of other HUDs. Ignored for menus.

hub.description: Compatibility spelling for catalog visibility. true marks the view for listing by Mod Settings and other `osfui/views` consumers; false makes it a hidden utility view and ineligible for discovered HUD auto-start.

debugOnly.description: When true, this view is kept out of the catalog unless the restart-latched osfui.developerMode setting is effective. It is still discovered and can be opened by qualified view id. Intended for local developer tools.

targetVersion.description: The OSF UI release version this view was authored against (e.g. "2.0.0"). A target NEWER than the running OSF UI release is advisory and badges 'needs update' in Mod Settings. A declared target BELOW 2.0 selects the frozen 1.x facade. An UNDECLARED targetVersion is deliberately treated as current rather than guessing which helper shape the page expects.

permissions.description: Capability grants. Everything defaults to deny.

nativeBridge.description: Inject window.osfui — the four verbs (send / request / on / state) and the page-initiated handshake. If false, no bridge is injected at all and the page runs purely client-side; osfui.available is then false and osfui.request() rejects with "no-bridge" rather than hanging.

filesystem.description: Reserved; no implementation enforces this yet.

network.description: Reserved; forced off with a warning if set true.
